dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline with a strong falcate curvature extending from the elongated posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a narrow pixel radius, exhibiting a distinct orientation toward the posterior (left of frame).
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis, following a slightly convex anterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum horizontal pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height ratio is approximately 3.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch is visible on the lower third of the trailing edge; irregular light-toned mottled patches and superficial marks are distributed across the mid-lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The fin exhibits an exceptionally elongated posterior attachment that tapers gradually into the dorsal ridge of the animal.
